subject: Insurance
title: The Insurance Gap Problem
description: One-minute skill: The Insurance Gap Problem.

hook.text: Globally, there's a $400 trillion life insurance gap.

buildup.text: In developing countries, less than 3% of the population has life insurance. Death leaves families in immediate poverty.

discovery.text: Even in the US, 40% of households would face financial hardship within six months if the primary earner died.

twist.text: Young people are the most underinsured—and the cheapest to cover. The gap exists partly because people delay buying.

climax.text: The insurance gap is the world's largest unmet financial need. Closing it would transform billions of lives.

punchline.text: $400 trillion gap. The world is massively underinsured against death.

quiz.question: How large is the global life insurance gap?
